mapper.insert:
insert into t_print_task (package_id, delivery_order_id, seq_no, template_id, copies, device_key, status, attempt_no, retry_of_task_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values
(#{t.packageId}, #{t.deliveryOrderId}, #{t.seqNo}, #{t.templateId}, coalesce(#{t.copies}, 1), #{t.deviceKey}, #{t.status}, coalesce(#{t.attemptNo}, 1), #{t.retryOfTaskId}, #{t.createBy}, #{t.createTime}, #{t.remark})
mapper.select: select t.*, o.code as deliveryCode, coalesce(c.alias, c.name) as customerName, cd.name as customerDeptName, o.delivery_date as deliveryDate, tp.name as templateName, tp.print_form as printForm from t_print_task t join t_delivery_order o on o.id = t.delivery_order_id left join t_customer c on c.id = o.customer_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = o.delivery_point_id left join t_print_template tp on tp.id = t.template_id where t.package_id = #{packageId} order by t.seq_no asc, t.id asc

select t.*, o.code as deliveryCode, coalesce(c.alias, c.name) as customerName, cd.name as customerDeptName, o.delivery_date as deliveryDate, tp.name as templateName, tp.print_form as printForm from t_print_task t join t_delivery_order o on o.id = t.delivery_order_id left join t_customer c on c.id = o.customer_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = o.delivery_point_id left join t_print_template tp on tp.id = t.template_id where t.id = #{id}
select status, count(1) as cnt from t_print_task where package_id = #{packageId} group by status
